::: {#rem-standard-error-name}
#### The name "standard error"

"Standard error" is a confusing name in two ways.
It is defined through the estimator's own spread,
not through the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error)
(although @thm-se-error-sd shows that the two spreads are equal).
It is also a synonym for the standard deviation of an estimator,
so it can look redundant.
The name persists because standard errors
are the building blocks of p-values and confidence intervals,
so they come up often enough to deserve their own name.
:::
